description: This source file implements the Encryption interface, providing methods for encrypting and decrypting strings using AES encryption with CBC mode and PKCS5 padding. It uses a fixed IV and manages secret keys, including conversion between bytes and hexadecimal strings.

classes.name: EncryptionImpl
classes.description: Class implementing encryption and decryption methods using AES encryption with CBC mode.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a string value using AES with CBC/PKCS5Padding, returning a hex-encoded string.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a hex-encoded string previously encrypted with the same key, returning the original string.

methods.name: bytesToHex
methods.description: Converts a byte array to its hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: hexToBytes
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string into its corresponding byte array.

methods.name: setSecretKey
methods.description: Sets the secret key used for encryption and decryption.

methods.name: getSecretKey
methods.description: Returns the current secret key used for encryption and decryption.
